$comment: Pieces of the Dungeon Modular Set V2 (C. Anastasiadis, CC-BY 4.0; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for scripts/art/kit/render_kit.py. Sizes at the Lords of Pain decor scale (29.6 px per tile), inside the decor plan's boxes (DECOR_BOX.candle 10 x 18 and .sarco 34 x 22 render px, x 1.85 to art px): the candle stand and the sarcophagus stand on far-wall tops; the banner hangs on a wall face (about the wall torch's size: the wall is one tile tall), rendered for the two faces the camera sees (rotZ: normal +X is facing 3 = SE 315, normal +Z is facing 2 = SW 225), the hidden facings copied. The tomb is the sarcophagus at world scale (unitsPerTile: its 225-unit length is 2 tiles), for solid decor (docs/DECOR.md "Solid decor"): tomb_x lies along X (rotZ 90), tomb_z along Z, each with its footprint centre written as the pivot. Room themes (docs/DECOR.md "Room themes"), also at world scale: the throne seated on its dais (moves; its 393-unit width is 4 tiles, footprint 4 x 2) and the statue on its round base with its candles and lectern (region; footprint 3 x 3), each facing +X (rotZ 180, _x) and +Z (rotZ 90, _z) with the footprint centre as pivot (pivotAt); the red carpet segment (2 x 2 tiles) along X and Z and its end piece pointing +X / +Z (the run leaves the throne that way).
